text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The day has finally arrived, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
On this day of your birth, when you first 
let out your resounding cry— I offer you 
my heartfelt congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that today? I completely and 
utterly forgot.

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Y-You forgot!? Heavens above! Is today not 
the day that all of heaven and earth bless 
your existence?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, you see. Growing older doesn't 
really change anything at all. You just 
feel a quiet gratitude for each ordinary 
day."

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. A special day calls for 'quiet 
contemplation.' —That aesthetic is truly 
excellent!

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, allow me to offer a 
"heartfelt" celebration as well!

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday... to you... Happy 
birthday... to you...

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday... dear... Beloved runner 
of the dirt and pride of the academy's 
wisdom, Acute-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the miracle of birth, the joy of 
meeting! I cannot express it all by 
myself! Come, let us sing together! Open 
your heart, and be free!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my, oh my. Heart is so bubbly~♪ 
Munching so crunchy~♪"

text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Brava! And for the grand finale, 
join me! ...Un, deux, trois... Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I thought I'd just quietly get a 
year older, but it looks like it's going 
to be a lively day.
